acceptance_criteria.condition: A root-cause conclusion cites a supported hypothesis with a hash-verified command, test, or trace output artifact rather than source code alone.
The validator and change-evidence gate reject undeclared references, path escapes, and stale evidence artifact digests.
The notification experiment reproduces three legacy deliveries and proves one durable-key delivery after an ambiguous timeout, restart, and concurrent duplicate messages.

invariants: Existing evidence artifacts without a causal block remain valid.
Causal artifact paths resolve only within the selected repository root.
CI must execute and compare a report before a test-output artifact can support a root-cause claim.
replaced_paths: Root-cause validation that accepted a supported hypothesis backed only by a hash-verified test source

safeguards.name: hash-verified causal artifacts
safeguards.rationale: The validator checks declared artifact IDs, repository-relative paths, SHA-256 digests, and hypothesis references.

safeguards.name: execution-evidence gate
safeguards.rationale: A root-cause fix requires a supported hypothesis to cite command output, test output, or a trace export.

safeguards.name: reproducible complex experiment
safeguards.rationale: CI regenerates and compares both causal experiment reports after their assertions run.

verification.result: 27 tests passed, including stale digest, path escape, source-only, gate, and report reproducibility failures.
The generated payment report matched its tracked execution artifact.
The generated concurrent timeout/retry notification report matched its tracked execution artifact.
Stored evidence and both causal examples validated with artifact hashes.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the validator, gate, policy text, report artifacts, examples, tests, CI report comparisons, and this evidence artifact together. Causal blocks remain optional for existing evidence artifacts.

independent_review.notes: Review found that source-only references did not prove execution; remediation now requires execution artifact kinds and CI report regeneration/comparison. Re-review found no remaining issues.

remaining_risks: A committed report can prove only the deterministic test scenario that CI reruns; it cannot replace production traces for unmodeled infrastructure or provider behavior.
Evidence summaries remain human-authored and require review even when their paths, hashes, and producing commands are verified.
